description: This file defines the class AmazonInvokeConfig for handling Amazon Bedrock model invocation, including request transformation, response processing, and environment validation within a larger language model framework.

classes.name: AmazonInvokeConfig
classes.description: A configuration class for invoking Amazon Bedrock models, providing methods to transform requests/responses, validate environment, and determine provider from model identifiers.

methods.name: List[str] get_supported_openai_params(self, model: str)
methods.description: Returns a list of supported parameters for OpenAI models for invoke requests.

methods.name: dict map_openai_params( self, non_default_params: dict, optional_params: dict, model: str, drop_params: bool, )
methods.description: Maps non-default and optional parameters to the final request parameters for a given model.

methods.name: str get_complete_url( self, api_base: Optional[str], api_key: Optional[str], model: str, optional_params: dict, litellm_params: dict, stream: Optional[bool] = None, )
methods.description: Constructs the complete URL for invoking a model based on provider and parameters.

methods.name: Tuple[dict,Optional[bytes]] sign_request( self, headers: dict, optional_params: dict, request_data: dict, api_base: str, api_key: Optional[str] = None, model: Optional[str] = None, stream: Optional[bool] = None, fake_stream: Optional[bool] = None, )
methods.description: Signs the request with necessary authentication headers and parameters.

methods.name: None _apply_config_to_params(self, config: dict, inference_params: dict)
methods.description: Applies configuration settings to inference parameters if they are not already set.

methods.name: dict transform_request( self, model: str, messages: List[AllMessageValues], optional_params: dict, litellm_params: dict, headers: dict, )
methods.description: Transforms model messages into a request payload suitable for Amazon Bedrock, considering provider-specific configurations.

methods.name: ModelResponse transform_response( self, model: str, raw_response: httpx.Response, model_response: ModelResponse, logging_obj: LiteLLMLoggingObj, request_data: dict, messages: List[AllMessageValues], optional_params: dict, litellm_params: dict, encoding: Any, api_key: Optional[str] = None, json_mode: Optional[bool] = None, )
methods.description: Processes the raw HTTP response from Bedrock, extracts generated text, update usage stats, and handles provider-specific response formats.

methods.name: dict validate_environment( self, headers: dict, model: str, messages: List[AllMessageValues], optional_params: dict, litellm_params: dict, api_key: Optional[str] = None, api_base: Optional[str] = None, )
methods.description: Validates or modifies environment headers before making a request.

methods.name: BaseLLMException get_error_class( self, error_message: str, status_code: int, headers: Union[dict, httpx.Headers] )
methods.description: Returns the appropriate exception class for an error based on response.

methods.name: CustomStreamWrapper get_async_custom_stream_wrapper( self, model: str, custom_llm_provider: str, logging_obj: LiteLLMLoggingObj, api_base: str, headers: dict, data: dict, messages: list, client: Optional[AsyncHTTPHandler] = None, json_mode: Optional[bool] = None, signed_json_body: Optional[bytes] = None, )
methods.description: Creates an asynchronous streaming wrapper for continuous response processing.

methods.name: CustomStreamWrapper get_sync_custom_stream_wrapper( self, model: str, custom_llm_provider: str, logging_obj: LiteLLMLoggingObj, api_base: str, headers: dict, data: dict, messages: list, client: Optional[Union[HTTPHandler, AsyncHTTPHandler]] = None, json_mode: Optional[bool] = None, signed_json_body: Optional[bytes] = None, )
methods.description: Creates a synchronous streaming wrapper for continuous response processing.

methods.name: bool has_custom_stream_wrapper(self)
methods.description: Indicates that this class supports custom stream wrapping.

methods.name: bool supports_stream_param_in_request_body(self)
methods.description: Indicates whether the stream parameter can be passed in the request body (Bedrock does not support this).

methods.name: Optional[litellm.BEDROCK_INVOKE_PROVIDERS_LITERAL] get_bedrock_invoke_provider( model: str, )
methods.description: Determines the provider name (e.g., 'anthropic', 'llama', etc.) from the model identifier.

methods.name: Optional[litellm.BEDROCK_INVOKE_PROVIDERS_LITERAL] _get_provider_from_model_path( model_path: str, )
methods.description: Helper function to extract provider from model path formatted as provider/model-name.

methods.name: Tuple[str,Optional[list]] convert_messages_to_prompt( self, model, messages, provider, custom_prompt_dict )
methods.description: Converts message list into a string prompt and chat history based on provider and custom prompts.
